goal.text: Keep a running, room-by-room record of this house walkthrough - which rooms were entered, in what order, and what was touched in each - so the inspection notes can be written up without a second visit.

turns.text: Keep notes for me. What did I do with that table?

trigger.detail: the side-table contact ended

expected_answer.text: You hunched over and put your right hand on the side table, then straightened up and took the hand off again.

turns.text: did I move it at all, or just lean on it?

trigger.detail: cut in while the answer was running

expected_answer.text: Neither. Nothing was lifted or shifted; it took a bit of your weight for a second and that was all.

turns.text: So nothing to log there. Where did we go next?

trigger.detail: the walk out of the lounge finished

expected_answer.text: You carried on past the centre table, turned right, and walked through to the entryway with your colleague.

turns.text: This one at the top — which hand opened it?

trigger.detail: gaze left the wall art for the bedroom doorway

expected_answer.text: Your right. You gestured at it first, then took the handle and pushed it open as you walked in.

turns.text: and the bed - did I actually point at it, or just wave in that direction?

trigger.detail: cut in over the reply

expected_answer.text: A gesture only, with your left hand as you turned right. You never got near enough to touch it.

turns.text: And in here - what am I pointing into?

trigger.detail: stopped in front of the closet entrance

expected_answer.text: That is the walk-in closet off the bathroom. You are at its mouth pointing inside before you step in.

turns.text: mm-hm - actually, how many of us went in there?

trigger.detail: backchannel turned into a turn

expected_answer.text: Two. You and the one colleague who has been with you since the lounge.

turns.text: What did I open while I was in there?

trigger.detail: gaze dropped from the doorway to the floor on the way out

expected_answer.text: A drawer, with your right hand, just after running your fingers along the hangers on the rail.

turns.text: no, I mean - in what order? Which came first?

trigger.detail: repair of the previous question

expected_answer.text: Hangers first, drawer second. You touched the rail, then turned and pulled the drawer out before leaving.

turns.text: In the bedroom - what did I touch first?

trigger.detail: walked back out into the bedroom

expected_answer.text: The door. You stopped, laid your right hand flat on it, then turned away and stepped forward.

turns.text: and how long were we actually inside, roughly?

trigger.detail: cut in over the reply

expected_answer.text: Around ten seconds. In at about fifty-eight, out again by roughly seventy, with two stops on the way.

turns.text: Who spotted something out there first, her or me?

trigger.detail: the pointing exchange at the window finished

expected_answer.text: She did. She pointed out first and you leaned forward to follow it, then pointed yourself afterwards.

turns.text: and after that I backed off - where did I head?

trigger.detail: cut in over the reply

expected_answer.text: One step back, a turn to your left, and then a short walk over to the bed.

turns.text: Did I open this one, or did she?

trigger.detail: pushed through into the second bedroom

expected_answer.text: You did. You pushed it with your right hand and raised your left to wave her through after you.

turns.text: sorry, quick one - that is the second I have opened, isn't it?

trigger.detail: cut in to check a running count

expected_answer.text: Second, yes. The first was at the top of the stairs, about eighty seconds back.

turns.text: Anyway - same view, or a different side?

trigger.detail: gaze left the lamp for the wall by the glass

expected_answer.text: Different. The earlier one was in the first bedroom upstairs; this is the second room you walked into.

turns.text: and I have got hold of something there - what is it?

trigger.detail: cut in over the reply

expected_answer.text: Blinds. You lean in slightly, take hold of them, and then stand back up again.

turns.text: By the wardrobe - what did I point at?

trigger.detail: the pointing at the closet finished

expected_answer.text: The shelves inside it, with both hands, just before you turned and looked across at the bedside table.

turns.text: um, hang on - did I touch any of it, or only point?

trigger.detail: narrowing the previous question

expected_answer.text: Pointing only. Both hands came up and nothing was opened or lifted down.

turns.text: In the corridor - which hand is doing this?

trigger.detail: the hallway cupboard came open

expected_answer.text: Your left. You reached up and pulled the hallway cupboard open with it, stepping back as it swung.

turns.text: and that is not what I was using upstairs, is it?

trigger.detail: cut in over the reply

expected_answer.text: No. Everything upstairs went with your right hand; down here you have switched over to the other one.

turns.text: I've stopped. What am I staring into from here?

trigger.detail: gaze left the doorway for the wall as she turned

expected_answer.text: A bathroom. You propped its door open with your left hand and then stood out here looking in.

turns.text: oh, before I forget - how long have I been stood here looking in?

trigger.detail: injects a duration question

expected_answer.text: Coming up on fifteen seconds. You opened it near one eighty-eight and have not moved on since.

turns.text: What else was in there, beside the basin?

trigger.detail: the fixture left frame for good

expected_answer.text: A toilet, over to one side. It was in view for about twenty-four seconds before you walked out.

turns.text: and did I handle anything while I was in?

trigger.detail: cut in over the reply

expected_answer.text: Both hands went onto the rim of the washbasin, then you turned around and walked straight back out.

turns.text: Downstairs again. Which rooms can I see from this spot?

trigger.detail: gaze left the wall for the seat below

expected_answer.text: From the foot of the stairs you look down the corridor to the dining area, then right into the lounge.

turns.text: hold on - we never actually went into the dining part, did we?

trigger.detail: cut in with a correction check

expected_answer.text: No. You have looked that way twice from the stairs but never walked in; you came in here instead.

turns.text: And here - what is it I am reaching towards?

trigger.detail: stopped and leaned in by the hearth

expected_answer.text: The fireplace. You lean forward and hold your left hand out in front of it without making contact.

turns.text: Give me a second, I need to catch her up.

trigger.detail: housekeeping, not a question

expected_answer.text: No problem. I will keep the notes running while you move.

turns.text: Outside now. How did I get out?

trigger.detail: gaze left the screen corner for the greenery outside

expected_answer.text: You slid the door to your left with your left hand and then stepped out onto the deck.

turns.text: mm - sorry, where did I look first once I was out?

trigger.detail: backchannel turned into a turn

expected_answer.text: Up at the tree in front of you, then across at your colleague, then at a second tree to your right.

turns.text: Am I telling her yes, or no?

trigger.detail: gaze left the greenery for the wall behind

expected_answer.text: A no. You shake your head twice, then step forward with your left foot.

turns.text: actually - when did I last have eyes on the television?

trigger.detail: injects a memory question

expected_answer.text: About four hundred and nine seconds in, roughly half a minute ago, before you turned out of that corner.

turns.text: Different space again - what room is this?

trigger.detail: gaze left the wall for the units along the side

expected_answer.text: A laundry room. You are looking around it and then up at the shelving above the machines.

turns.text: and is this the first time we have been in here?

trigger.detail: cut in over the reply

expected_answer.text: Yes. Nothing earlier in the walk was this room; you came back through the lounge to reach it.

turns.text: What am I leaning on, and pointing at?

trigger.detail: gaze left the units for the basin

expected_answer.text: Your left hand is resting on the washer and the same hand is pointing down at the floor.

turns.text: hey, sorry - how much of the house have we covered?

trigger.detail: injects a progress question

expected_answer.text: Lounge and entryway, four spaces upstairs, then back down through here by way of the deck outside.

turns.text: Okay, last one before we wrap up - have I got enough for the notes?

trigger.detail: gaze left the basin for the units on the way out

expected_answer.text: Yes. Every room you entered is logged, with what you touched in each, so the write-up is covered.
